name: yonkoma
title: Yonkoma
description: A four-panel strip read top to bottom, to explain something in four beats. The API is four children, one per panel, plus an optional title box; the panels are Panels on a PanelGrid (3px frames, a list of four for screen readers with a label per panel) with a small number box in the corner. orientation="horizontal" puts the four in a row in the manga reading order; "auto" stacks them on phones and lines them up once the strip's container is 40rem wide. Any aspect ratio per panel.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/yonkoma". Each child fills its panel (an absolute, overflow-hidden box): position your art and bubbles inside it. Pass labels so each panel has a spoken description.

meta.tagline: Four panels, top to bottom, to tell it in four beats.
meta.usage:
import { Yonkoma } from "@/components/manga/yonkoma"

<Yonkoma title="How it works" labels={["Install", "Import", "Style", "Ship"]}>
  <StepOne />
  <StepTwo />
  <StepThree />
  <StepFour />
</Yonkoma>

props.name: children
props.description: Four children, one per panel. Extra ones are left out.

props.name: numbered
props.description: Number box in each panel's corner.

props.name: labels
props.description: Spoken description of each panel (default "Panel 1 of 4"…).

props.name: orientation
props.description: A column, a row in the reading order, or a column that becomes a row from 40rem.
